title: Closed subscheme cut out by ideals on affine opens compatible with principal opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For an affine open $U\subseteq X$ and $f\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ let $U_f=\{x\in U: \text{the germ }f_x\text{ is a unit of }\mathcal O_{X,x}\}$ be the principal open of $U$ defined by $f$ (under an isomorphism $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_X(U)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] it corresponds to $D(f)$). (0) $U_f$ is an affine open of $X$ and the restriction map $\mathcal O_X(U)\to\mathcal O_X(U_f)$ is a localization of $\mathcal O_X(U)$ at $f$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. (1) Suppose given, for every affine open $U\subseteq X$, an ideal $I_U\subseteq\mathcal O_X(U)$ such that for every affine open $U$ and every $f\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ the ideal $I_{U_f}$ is generated by the image of $I_U$ under the restriction $\mathcal O_X(U)\to\mathcal O_X(U_f)$. Then there is a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal sheaf $\mathcal I=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] satisfies $\mathcal I(U)=I_U$ for every affine open $U$; for every affine open $U$, $i^{-1}(U)\to U$ is isomorphic over $U$ to $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_X(U)/I_U)\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_X(U)\cong U$ (the morphism induced by the quotient map); and $i(Z)\cap U$ is the set of $x\in U$ whose prime $\mathfrak p_x\subset\mathcal O_X(U)$ contains $I_U$, i.e. corresponds to $V(I_U)$.
